_meta.severity: code = grounded in live enforcement/legislation, HARD failure, never relaxable by the model; guideline = responsible-design convention, relaxable with a recorded justification

loot_box_minors.trigger: paid random-reward mechanics reachable by players under 18 (under 16 without parental consent)
jurisdictions: Brazil: U18 loot-box ban effective Mar 2026
FTC/Genshin 2025: no loot boxes to U16 without parental consent
Australia 2024: paid loot boxes => M minimum rating
loot_box_minors.fix: remove paid randomization, or age-gate 18+ with rating consequences stated

odds_disclosure.trigger: paid random rewards without disclosed odds
jurisdictions: FTC Epic/Fortnite $245M settlement lineage; platform policies (Apple/Google) require odds
odds_disclosure.fix: set monetization.odds_disclosed=true and surface exact probabilities in-game

multi_hop_currency.trigger: more than one premium-currency conversion between real money and the purchasable item
jurisdictions: FTC/Genshin 2025 order: no multi-hop currency price obscuring
multi_hop_currency.fix: collapse to a single conversion; show real-money price at point of sale

real_price_display.trigger: virtual-currency prices without real-money equivalent display
jurisdictions: EU CPC 2025 virtual-currency principles (enforced, Star Stable)
real_price_display.fix: display real-currency price alongside virtual pricing

countdown_minors.trigger: countdown/pressure offers in a product whose audience includes minors
jurisdictions: EU CPC 2025: no pressure tactics on children
countdown_minors.fix: remove countdown timers from offers, or age-gate the product 18+

streak_no_grace.trigger: streak mechanics without free repair/grace, or with paid-only repair
jurisdictions: module rule per A18 (FTC dark-pattern lineage); appointment mechanics reward presence, never punish absence
streak_no_grace.fix: add free grace (>=1 missed day) and never sell what lapsing deleted

absence_punishment.trigger: removing earned content/progress for not logging in
absence_punishment.fix: reward presence instead; lapsing may pause, never delete

binge_upsell.trigger: monetization offers triggered by long-session/binge detection
jurisdictions: module rule per A18; binge episodes independently predict harm (meta-analytic evidence)
binge_upsell.fix: binge detection triggers care messaging (breaks), never offers

gacha_pity_hidden.trigger: pity/hazard mechanics whose parameters are not player-visible
gacha_pity_hidden.fix: publish pity thresholds or at least consolidated rates

loot_box_spend_link.trigger: any paid loot box in a product aimed at a general audience
jurisdictions: evidence: loot-box spend <-> problem gambling meta-analytic r=0.26; the randomization itself is the risk factor (non-random IAP eta2=0.004)
loot_box_spend_link.fix: prefer direct purchase / battle-pass models; if kept, document the mitigation set
